answer: The pigment schedule is applied in reef and plume shows each instalment. A payout is split so that 21% arrives at settlement and the rest over 15 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 749 identities would post 1004 proofs and burn roughly 57 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
